status: Desktop repair build verified in representative browser views
browser: Codex in-app Chromium browser; final visual pass used WebGL 2 fallback
observations: Complete preload reaches the opening Explore / Cinematic choice without texture or shader errors.
Founder, studio, lounge and exterior reference cameras show corrected source textures and illumination. Previously black founder desk and studio furniture are lit.
The automatic 58-second route passes the exterior and entrance into the lounge and reaches Explore freely at the natural stop.
Pause holds the cinematic; replay and the exploration handoff work.
Opening Explore enters the source lounge with a visible third-person character and correct camera distance.
V switches to a stable eye-level body camera and restores third person. Drag-to-look changes the view; looking down shows the body.
L requests cursor lock. The embedded browser declined lock; the explicit drag-to-look fallback worked. Lock acquisition in an external browser has not been manually verified.
E approaches and sits in chair-03. The seated camera frames the physical display without the prior collapsed-camera obstruction.
Clicking Explore Work on the physical display changes its content to Selected Work. E stands and restores exploration.
Esc opens the menu and replay returns to the cinematic.
The final head-visibility regression keeps the head visible during the distant part of the V transition and hides it only near the eye position.
limits: Representative visual inspection is not a pixel-by-pixel comparison of every material, view and room against Cycles.
Final browser verification was on WebGL 2. WebGPU shaders were checked in earlier repair stages; the final production pass did not obtain a WebGPU adapter.
All four source chairs are validated numerically; the final manual browser sit/stand smoke test covered chair-03.
No sustained performance benchmark, mobile-device qualification or low-memory-device guarantee was performed.
The full high-detail scene remains resident; resolution adaptation does not reduce geometry or texture residency.
Illumination is ray traced offline in Cycles. Browser rendering uses baked GI, live sunlight/shadows and static reflection probes, not hardware ray tracing.
Reference-exact presentation content is the later content phase; the in-world screen currently proves the interaction system.
Public Vercel deployment and domain setup have not been performed.
client_visual_approval: pending; automated and agent review are not client approval
